_envelopes: Each envelope has its own file and its own recipients: the same envelope to several people = a backup, different envelopes to different people = nobody holds everything. The older envelope_path + friend_email form still works.

envelopes.note: These are the remaining credentials, not the wallet passphrase.

_lang: Each recipient can have their own language (en, sk, cs); the default is en.
_signal: An optional second channel. Leave out the whole `signal` block and every `*_signal` number and everything goes by e-mail alone.
_options: confirm_quorum = how many distinct confirmers are needed (default 1). Increment checkin_key_version if the check-in link leaks. smtp_timeout bounds the whole SMTP conversation.
